title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: The Fuel Dock (1/3)

characters.Kai: KAI; one flip-flop left until Part 3, then barefoot
characters.Dana: nurse in teal hospital scrubs, voice [woman]; worked with Tess's mother at Mercy Hospital

scenes.narration: If you need fuel in an outbreak, don't start the pump. Sound carries farther over water.
The fishing boat reached the marina fuel dock at midnight.
One pier. Two pumps. And four hundred yards of dark water between them and the town.
[man] Quarter tank. [man] We fill up, or we drift.
The pump needed power. Power meant the generator. And a generator is the loudest thing on a dock.
[kai] So we don't use the pump.
Kai found a hose, and an empty fuel can.
A siphon needs no power. Fill the hose, keep the can lower than the tank, and gravity does the rest.
[tess] Don't use your mouth! Fuel in your lungs can kill you.
So they sank the whole hose in the tank, thumbed the end, and pulled it down.
Tess wrapped the metal can in her hoodie, so it wouldn't clank.
Three cans. Four. The gauge crept up.
Then every light on the dock came on.
Somewhere on shore, someone had started the generator.
And in the town, four hundred yards away, every head turned.
Stay or go? Part two is next.
